mechanism: Carisoprodol is metabolized by CYP2C19 to meprobamate; amiodarone inhibits CYP2C19 and CYP3A4, potentially increasing carisoprodol/meprobamate levels and CNS depression risk.
action: Monitor for increased CNS depression (drowsiness, dizziness, confusion); consider dose reduction of carisoprodol if combined therapy is necessary; counsel patient on avoiding alcohol and other CNS depressants.
